title: Belly Full of Turkey
cn: 第 9 集 · 装满火鸡的肚子
novel:
Thanksgiving arrived, and Marshall took Lily home to meet the [[in-laws|in-laws]].

His mother had [[roasted|roast]] a bird the size of a dog. There was [[stuffing|stuffing]], brown [[gravy|gravy]], and a [[greasy|greasy]] pile of potatoes. It was a proper [[feast|feast]]. Lily smiled politely through one long [[awkward silence|awkward silence]] after another, then asked for [[seconds|seconds]] to make everyone happy.

By nine o'clock she had lost her [[appetite|appetite]], [[unbuttoned|unbutton]] her jeans under the table, and started to [[doze off|doze off]] on the sofa. Marshall said the family [[tradition|tradition]] was simple: eat until you cannot move, then take a [[nap|nap]].

Back in the city, Ted spent the day in a [[soup kitchen|soup kitchen]]. He signed up as a [[volunteer|volunteer]] for a small [[charity|charity]] and served hot food to [[homeless|homeless]] people all afternoon. The cook was rude; the guests were [[generous|generous]] with their thanks.

It was [[humble|humble]] work, and Ted felt strangely [[grateful|grateful]] for it.

That night, [[stuffed|stuffed]] and sleepy, everyone counted their [[blessings|blessing]]. Nobody said anything wise. They simply [[overate|overeat]] together, which is what families do.

in-laws.en: the family of your husband or wife

roast.en: to cook meat in an oven

stuffing.en: a soft mix of bread and herbs cooked inside a bird

gravy.en: a brown sauce made from the juice of cooked meat

feast.en: a big special meal for many people

awkward silence.en: a quiet moment when nobody knows what to say

seconds.en: a second plate of the same food

appetite.en: the feeling of wanting to eat

unbutton.en: to open the buttons of clothes

doze off.en: to fall asleep slowly, without meaning to

tradition.en: something a family or country has done for many years

nap.en: a short sleep in the day

soup kitchen.en: a place that gives free food to poor people

volunteer.en: a person who works to help others without pay

charity.en: an organisation that helps people in need

generous.en: happy to give time, money or kind words

stuffed.en: so full of food that you cannot eat more

blessing.en: a good thing in your life that you are thankful for

overeat.en: to eat more than you need
